messages:
marco: Heads-up: external pentest vendor wants a targeted engagement on staging next Monday. They request Encrypt/Decrypt on one test KMS key and an assume-role for API calls. Proposing a 3hr corridor 09:30-12:30 PDT. Any objections?

annie: OK from product side. Please scope to a single key and ephemeral creds. We should also add an IP restriction for the vendor during the window.

sarah: Agree. Plan: create a dedicated test key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:555555:key/staging-pt-key, key policy denies PutKeyPolicy/ScheduleKeyDeletion. Provide an IAM role with only kms:Encrypt,kms:Decrypt and sts:AssumeRole. TTL 1h. I can own the role issuance.

devops-bot: infra note: we'll add terraform module for role + IP whitelist. Example assume flow to provide to vendor:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::555555:role/pt-staging-access --role-session-name ptvendor --duration-seconds 3600
```
PR will be tagged "pt:infra" and request expedited review.

marco: Good. Audit requirements: we must export CloudTrail to the secure bucket with write-once retention for 90 days. Who confirms export timing?

audit-bot: scheduled export: CloudTrail -> s3://secure-logbox/pt-engagements/4130009999 at 12:40 PDT. Retention: immutable 90d. (automated)

annie: Evidence collection checklist (attach to each finding ticket): CloudTrail event IDs for kms:Encrypt/Decrypt and iam:AssumeRole, VPC flow logs for tester IPs, app request logs with trace ids, and request/response captured when possible. Use label "pt-staging-4130009999".

sarah: We'll also set a CloudWatch metric filter: threshold >50 kms:Decrypt calls/min from single principal -> alert. Page only for critical bursts >150/min during corridor. Medium/low go to triage board.

claire: For RBAC, avoid broad policy changes during corridor. If mitigation needed, do a PR with expedited reviewers (marco + sarah) and no wildcard allows. Small emergency exceptions only.

marco: Retest plan: vendor to re-run specific tests within 4 business days after we mark fixes verified. Request a 2hr retest slot; use same role/key for parity. Keep retest scope per-finding.

devops-bot: bridge created: https://infra.company/bridges/pt-4130009999 (automated)

annie: I'll prep a repro template and ticket template (fields: summary, CVSS, steps, PoC, ARNs, CloudTrail ids, S3 evidence path). Aim to have templates ready by Thu EOD.

sarah: I'll add the key policy snippet and the terraform change to the infra repo; dropping link here once PR is ready. Also adding a read-only CloudTrail viewer role for reviewers to avoid granting key-write perms.

claire: Oncall paging: only for high/critical with active exploit or service impact. All other severities land in triage and get normal cadence.

marco: Action list recap:
- sarah/devops: terraform role + key + IP whitelist (PR by Thu EOD)
- audit-bot/ops: confirm CloudTrail export & immutability (confirm Wed)
- annie: repro & ticket templates (Thu EOD)
- claire: expedite reviewer + oncall rules

marco: If no objections by EOD tomorrow we lock the corridor and merge infra PR after reviews. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
